stem: What is the message of this poem?

options.label: F
options.text: Time moves at the same pace no matter what is happening.

options.label: G
options.text: Time seems to pass more quickly in the morning than in the evening.

options.label: H
options.text: The passage of time is usually noticed more by older people than by younger people.

options.label: J
options.text: Time seems to pass at different speeds depending on what we are doing.
